name: G M Breweries Ltd
about: G M Breweries Ltd, set up in 1981 manufactures and markets Alcoholic Beverages such as Country Liquor (CL) and Indian-made Foreign Liquor (IMFL). [1]
keyPoints:
Milestones[1]
The Co. has a monopoly in country liquor in the districts of Mumbai, Thane & Palghar. 
It is the single largest manufacturer of country liquor in the State of Maharashtra with a sizable market share.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.32% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.49.6 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 10.9% of profits over last 3 years
